mechanism_narrative: Rising inflation as measured by CPIAUCSL leads to tighter monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces consumer spending, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL rises above 5% YoY and S&P 500 still produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a weakening economy, leading to negative investor sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE increases and S&P 500 still produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in housing starts (HOUST) indicates a slowdown in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic downturns, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST decreases > 10% YoY and S&P 500 still produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a strengthening economy, leading to positive investor sentiment and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO increases and S&P 500 still produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary cycle, which reduces borrowing costs and stimulates economic activity, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS decreases > 0.25% and S&P 500 still produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a strengthening labor market, which leads to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS increases and S&P 500 still produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) indicates a weakening economy, leading to negative investor sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS decreases > 5% YoY and S&P 500 still produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 5% and inflation (CPIAUCSL) is rising, the combination signals a tightening monetary policy and inflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 5% and CPIAUCSL > 5% YoY and S&P 500 still produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances.
